snippet.title: Punch Chess - Atari 2600 Homebrew
snippet.description:
This Atari 2600 (NTSC) game has been developed for the jam Inspired by... retro game jam. It was inspired by two games proposed as jam inspiration themes (punch out and turmoil - for the type of movement) 

Developed by kamaleon70
Download: https://kamaleon70.itch.io/punch-chess
Also nominated for "Atari 2600: Best Homebrew ≤ 4K (Original + Port)" at the 7th Annual Atari Homebrew Awards over at AtariAge.
Other nominations:
- "Atari 2600 Homebrew ≤ 4K Graphics (Original + Port)"
- Atari 2600 Homebrew ≤ 4K Music & Sound (Original + Port)
